answer: By the zephyr of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The relic lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mirror is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
